search.website_text:
Another leve turnin plugin that might never get finished # Chilled Leves (Leves are better cold)
Another leve turnin plugin that might never get finished

**Please Note** this is currently actively under development. There might be things that break, but I'm trying my darndest to get it up and running how it should be.   
Repo: `https://puni.sh/api/repository/ice`

### Currently supports
✔️ Turnins for Crafters  
✔️ Support for a list to be able to grab and turnin from each NPC  
✔️ Turnins for Fisher (From ARR -> DT)   
✔️ Gathering Farm mode (Currently supports fisher) where you can run until you complete all the leves at the vendor or until you hit x level 
✔️ Multi-Grab Leves | Multi-Turnin Leves from the same NPC if you have them done

### Current Plans
- [ ] Improve the Turnin NPC to see if there are multiple leves to be turned in
- [ ] Fix mount roulette (for characters that only have 1 mount)
- [ ] More to come as I think about it

Future plans:
- [ ] Make it to where if you're at the leve vendor, able to grab multiple classes of leves if possible [Not just CUL for instance, but CUL, BSM, and ARM if they're all in the same city]
- [ ] Provide an indicator for all potentional leves that you can do in the main Ui (might have to look into allagan tools for this implimentation)

variant.changelog:
## V1.0.2.0 Release

### New Features
- Gathering support has been added for BTN/MIN leves from ARR->DT
	- All routes should be fully mapped out, there is 2 that *-will-* prove to probably be impossible right now (they're both miner, they're both in ARR, and they're both in thanalan)
	- Everything below lv. 60 is only supported in the ARR/HW grind tab. This is due to the nature of rerolling for leves, and how much of a PITA it is to deal with them. So if you want to do those, use that mode (you can't add them to the normal list reguardless as a safety protocol)
- Ui has been given a *-massive-* overhaul. (It looks so pretty ~)
- Leve Playlist as well as the ARR/HW Grind (originally named priorty grind) now supports drag->dropping the order of leves instead of having some arbitrary number to say what you want to do

***[User Info]***
- Added a tab to keep track of all your alts and main's leves counter. This also contains the ability to select which ones you would like to actually get alerts on, as well as hide them entirely. 
	- Also has the ability to anomymize names for screenshot purposes of bugs and such, I know you don't want people to know how many you have and who they are >.>
	- There's an option to auto-enable upon a new character in the Settings Menu

***[Settings]***
- Complete overhaul from what it used to be
- Allows searching in the top bar to quickly find them based on tags/names

***[Gathering Profiles]***

## V1.0.2.0 Release

### New Features
- Gathering support has been added for BTN/MIN leves from ARR->DT
	- All routes should be fully mapped out, there is 2 that *-will-* prove to probably be impossible right now (they're both miner, they're both in ARR, and they're both in thanalan)
	- Everything below lv. 60 is only supported in the ARR/HW grind tab. This is due to the nature of rerolling for leves, and how much of a PITA it is to deal with them. So if you want to do those, use that mode (you can't add them to the normal list reguardless as a safety protocol)
- Ui has been given a *-massive-* overhaul. (It looks so pretty ~)
- Leve Playlist as well as the ARR/HW Grind (originally named priorty grind) now supports drag->dropping the order of leves instead of having some arbitrary number to say what you want to do

***[User Info]***
- Added a tab to keep track of all your alts and main's leves counter. This also contains the ability to select which ones you would like to actually get alerts on, as well as hide them entirely. 
	- Also has the ability to anomymize names for screenshot purposes of bugs and such, I know you don't want people to know how many you have and who they are >.>
	- There's an option to auto-enable upon a new character in the Settings Menu

***[Settings]***
- Complete overhaul from what it used to be
- Allows searching in the top bar to quickly find them based on tags/names

***[Gathering Profiles]***
- Allows for creating profiles per type of gathering mission, with defaults pre-built in
	- This system was brought over from cosmic, and before Gather & Chill's auto-gathering buffs were created. . . will probably merge that over in some time later

## Misc Changes
- A lot of backend code was refined to be more particular. Ex. The turnin npc should ACTUALLY BE WHO IT SAYS IT IS >.> (Thanks fishing/gathering for being really dumb about this)
- Lot of code cleanup, some more theme changes. Overall, just good qol

variant.changelog:
- If you're < 7 yalms away from the npc you're interacting with, it should continue on like normal (this is mainly a fix for the specific fisher leve vendor that everyone uses)
	- Speaking of them, adjusted the turnin point to be a bit more sane to allow for the above to work ^

### Gathering Playlist
- Changed all the checkboxes to buttons
	- It looks better
	- Fight me
	- I'm sick, you'll probably win
- Re-added the "repeat last leve" per a nicer's user request and not the snot nose one who decided to be rude and not even ask the time of day
- Fixed an issue where it was **still** sticking leves down, even though it shouldn't of to begin with *sigh*
- Re-added the export to TC button (it was kinda forgotten ngl), and fixed it to properly export the list instead of just grabbing *-everything-*

### ARR/HW Grind
- Renamed to gathering grind
	- Why? Because it's literally only gatherers. And also it supports but isn't required for lv. 70+ now
- Reworked the leve selection popup to allow for searching names, and sorting each job by lv. 
- Also, when you've completed every leve for that vendor, you'll get a nice little checkmark with it
- Stb+ leves aren't *-required-* for this, but since I was already doing it, figured i'd alteast give ya the option for it...

### Ui Changes
- Compact sidebar actually does something instead of being a sudo button
- Sidebar now has tooltips above it. So maybe people will read (they won't)

### Misc
- I probably forgot something. I'm unsure what it is...
